args.body: Take DOCS-REQUEST-FULFILLMENT. Optimize for a concrete unresolved request and useful delivery, not another generic audit or launch-copy rewrite. Existing artifacts prove neither buyer interest nor revenue. Inspect submission and AI rules before preparing a patch; Requests is excluded from autonomous submission. Use only the five fetched candidates, and record a bounded rejection if none qualifies. Distinguish a reviewable local patch, an external submission, an accepted contribution, an interested buyer and verified payment. No external action is authorized through an unrelated account.

description: The Requests sample verified no defect and no buyer interest. Shift to one active, public documentation repair request; qualify its submission rules before preparing a targeted deliverable. Funding and revenue remain unverified.
